traits.leader.note: Sargent's Manual (sargent-1922, p. 378): 'a bushy tree ... with a single straight trunk'.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): plants 50-100 (to 150) dm.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): to 150 dm.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): trees, clonal.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves tardily falling, leathery: kept through the year.

traits.spines.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): no armature described.

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): plants clonal.

traits.bark_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): bark brown or grey, peeling in long red-brown strips; drawn red-brown; sRGB by eye.

traits.leaf_colour.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: leaves dark glossy green above, paler and felted beneath.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves opposite, as Jepson and other Californian floras key the genus.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: each opposite pair crossing the pair below (decussate), as opposite leaves stand on an upright shoot.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus floribundus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): on Santa Catalina most plants have undivided leaves; on San Clemente, Santa Cruz and Santa Rosa and in part on Catalina they are palmately or pinnately divided, usually into 3-5 (to 7) pinnately lobed leaflets: divided on most of the islands, so usually compound, sometimes simple.

traits.division_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus floribundus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): palmately or pinnately divided; drawn pinnate.

traits.division_order.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus floribundus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets lobed, not divided again.

traits.terminal_leaflet.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus floribundus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): the divided leaf ends in a leaflet.

traits.leaflets.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets 3-7, usually 3-5.

traits.leaflet_incision.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaflets usually pinnately lobed, the lobes oblong-rounded to falcate or nearly triangular, broadly attached, their bases often overlapping.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: leaves 8 cm to 20 cm long with the petiole.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus floribundus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petiole 12-35 mm, often winged.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): simple blades or leaflets 6-18 cm long.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: leaflets 1.2 cm to 2.5 cm wide across the lobes.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blades or leaflets elliptic, lance-linear, lanceolate or oblong; drawn lanceolate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): margins somewhat revolute, entire, crenulate or serrate; drawn entire on the lobes.

traits.leaf_hairs_beneath.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus floribundus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): abaxial surface tomentose, slowly glabrescent.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): compound corymbs or panicles, terminal; drawn as a flat-topped corymb.

traits.inflorescence_branches.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: the compound corymb's 8 to 16 primary branches, each branching again to its flowers; FNA gives no count.

traits.inflorescence_outline.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: broad flat-topped flower clusters.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): 50-800+ flowers.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: clusters 10 cm to 20 cm across.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers (5-)6-8 mm across.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals white; sRGB by eye.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens (12-)15+ in one series.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits aggregated follicles, 2 (or 3).

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): follicles 3-4 mm.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: dry follicles brown, with the old flowers left rusty brown on the tree.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 9 (2014), Lyonothamnus floribundus (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowering May to July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: follicles ripe late summer and autumn.

appearance.note: Every look comes from the characters through the library's rules: a slim evergreen tree with peeling red-brown bark, opposite fern-like leaves of lobed leaflets and broad flat heads of tiny white flowers.

allometry.note: 10.0 m tall at 30 years in the open, the top of the floras' usual 5-10 m (it grows to 15), as grown taller than that (11.8 m) on 2026-10-19. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
